# Semlink 2.2.0

A major usability and reliability release: the workspace becomes a real home inside Obsidian, streaming output is rebuilt for smoothness, and the persistence layer gets a ground-up fix.

## New home & workspace integration

- New tabs (+ / Ctrl+T) open the Semlink home page instead of an empty tab (configurable in settings).
- Settings now render inside the view, in the same full-screen form as the Get Started hub — no more invisible or greyed-out settings dialogs.
- Chat pop-out window: move the current session to a floating 780x720 window via the picture-in-picture button; closing it returns the session to the sidebar intact. Widths at or below 600px automatically collapse the menu back into the drawer.
- History menu is always visible in main-area and pop-out instances and refreshes in real time as sessions are saved.

## Streaming & reading experience

- Typewriter streaming rebuilt in three layers (stable region / typing tail) with requestAnimationFrame frame locking for smooth output.
- Streaming text no longer force-follows scroll while you are reading.
- Citation markers are normalized; a new Base Citation toggle is available.
- Traffic-light status dots; scroll-following during thinking generation fixed.

## Persistence reliability

- Root-cause fix for data loss on reload or process kill: per-note real-time persistence at millisecond level, with durable whole-database snapshots merged into a maintenance cycle running at least every 10 minutes.
- Indexed counts in the modal, status bar and hero card are unified to one source of truth (Embedded + Skipped).
- Rebuild stays clickable while a run is in progress (abort waits for exit, then clears).
- Stale on-disk vault.db and bak-* files are auto-cleaned after migration; close() now terminates the old worker, fixing NoModificationAllowed load failures.
- Re-embedding root-cause fix (mtime zeroing + vector adjudication short-circuit + unified entry point): notes are never silently re-embedded.
- OPFS storage monitoring in the debug toolkit.

## Search & indexing

- Semantic search gains a path pre-filter: limit results to a folder or a single note, from both MCP and the chat agent.
- Silent reconciliation: a full mtime sweep 8 seconds after load, plus focus-throttled sweeps (at most once per 5 minutes), catching change events missed while the window was reloaded or closed and background external writes.
- Rename handling fixed: true renames update the path in place without re-embedding; moves from excluded directories into scope are now enqueued for indexing.
- CORS fallback to non-streaming requests; test-connection verdicts fixed.
- Excluded directories are no longer picked up by auto-indexing.

## Sharing & onboarding

- Share any note to your LAN from the editor title bar: two-state share icon, QR code, chunked rendering that keeps the editor responsive, and a table-of-contents outline on wide screens.
- Get Started is now a universal hub: welcome banner plus official site / Discord / chat setup / embedding setup cards, a confetti welcome for new users, and a journey restart button.
- Onboarding copy refreshed across all 11 languages.

## Model & settings pages

- Provider and model pages rebuilt Cherry-style: horizontal tab navigation, API key management as a modal, and no more list jumping on selection (auto-reordering removed).
- Long model lists scroll correctly; dark theme adaptations throughout.
- Pro license identity card; endpoint switching row; series picker modal.

## Platform & tools

- Obsidian 1.15 adaptation.
- New web_search and mcp_info tools for the chat agent; debug toolkit extended (model/chatview probes, rpcdiag/noteprobe performance forensics, startup chain slimming).
- MCP: vault-relative path normalization for search/keyword/ls/grep/find — absolute disk paths now resolve correctly.
- Brand name unified to "Semlink" across the sidebar tab title, ribbon tooltip and command palette (11 languages).
